subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a stable plugin SDK API, or should exact-profile usage remain an owner-specific/internal capability until a narrower approved contract exists?
rationale: This is an additive plugin API that exposes provider-auth behavior across all plugin consumers; tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine the intended permanent SDK boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow API contract
options.body: Accept the token-free, exact-profile, no-refresh read as a supported plugin SDK seam after live proof is added.

options.title: Keep it owner-specific for now
options.body: Remove the public runtime SDK exposure and retain any needed usage logic behind the specific owner plugin until an approved cross-plugin use case exists.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API contract
recommendation.body: Accept the token-free, exact-profile, no-refresh read as a supported plugin SDK seam after live proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed API design and implementation context, although final SDK contract approval requires a repository decision-maker.
